job.job_description:
About the Role


We are hiring a Django Developer to build and manage backend systems for our web
applications. You will be responsible for creating robust, scalable APIs, integrating
databases, and ensuring smooth backend logic for our products.


Key Responsibilities


Develop and maintain backend services using Django and Django REST Framework
(DRF).


Design, build, and optimize REST APIs for web and mobile applications.


Work with relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL).


Implement authentication, authorization, and role-based access control.


Integrate external APIs and third-party services.


Write reusable, testable, and efficient code.


Work closely with frontend developers and product teams to deliver features.


Maintain documentation, perform code reviews, and ensure best coding practices.
Required Skills


Strong proficiency in Python and Django.


Deep understanding of Django ORM & DRF.


Experience with PostgreSQL/MySQL.


Knowledge of HTML, CSS, basic JavaScript (for debugging).


Experience with Git, Docker, CI/CD pipelines.


Good understanding of security, scalability, and API design principles.


Good to Have


Experience with Celery, Redis, caching frameworks.


Knowledge of cloud deployments (AWS/GCP).


Experience with microservices architecture.


Familiarity with async frameworks (FastAPI).
